blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Friday acquitted former Albay Gov. Edcel Greco Lagman on the charges of indirect bribery and violation of the Anti-Illegal Gambling law after the witnesses who alleged that he was involved in jueteng operations recanted their statements. “[T]he Court holds that reasonable doubts are present as regards Lagman’s guilt, necessitating an acquittal pursuant to the constitutional presumption of innocence,” the court said in a briefer of its decision. In 2024, a former village official of Daraga town filed administrative and criminal charges before the Office of the Ombudsman against Lagman for allegedly receiving around […]...
